concept.zh: 改变一位并观察数值变化
concept.en: Change one bit and observe the value

brief.zh: 拨动开关，在二进制读数和十进制读数之间来回看。试着只改变一位，比较哪一位带来的变化更大。
brief.en: Flip the switches and compare the binary and decimal readings. Change just one bit at a time to see which position makes a bigger difference.

hints.zh: 先在三位例子里翻动最左和最右各一次。再换成四位，看看增加一位带来了多大的数。
hints.en: In a three-bit example, flip the leftmost switch and then the rightmost one. Switch to four bits to see how much the extra position can add.
